_readme: Justified exceptions to the security invariants in test/security/invariants/*.test.js.
Each entry: { "rule": "<rule id>", "file": "<repo-relative path>", "contains"?: "<text in the violation>", "reason": "<why this is safe>" }.
The reason must say why the flagged code cannot be reached by untrusted input (not just 'false positive').
Entries that no longer match anything fail the test: delete them in the same change that fixes the code.
Rule ids and what they mean: test/security/invariants/_lib/rules.js. How to add one: test/security/README.md.

entries.reason: selectedPreset is one of the hardcoded local-LLM presets in src/services/apiKeyManager.js (docsUrl is a fixed https:// constant or null); no user, file or network data reaches it.
